source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Document the make and model of the appliance.
3. Record the serial number, if available.
4. Note the date and time of the safety check.
5. Identify the tester (name and qualification).
6. Describe the testing procedure followed.
7. Detail each test parameter and its expected value versus the actual observed value (for example: insulation resistance, earth continuity, polarity, etc.).
8. Specify any parts or components that failed.
9. Indicate the nature of the failure or issue (e.g., frayed wires, damaged insulation, overheating, etc.).
10. Take photographs of the failure points if possible, and include them in the record.
11. Include any additional observations and remarks.
12. Provide recommendations for remediation (repair or replacement, etc.).
13. Obtain an electronic or handwritten signature from the tester certifying the accuracy of the check.
14. Secure the appliance to prevent its use until remediation.
15
